access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password=next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'))['access_token']

# Eligible songs in library: release year <= 2021
library_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    library_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

eligible_song_ids=[]
release_year={}
for s in library_songs:
    det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['song_id'])
    rd=det.get('release_date')
    if rd:
        yr=int(rd[:4])
        release_year[s['song_id']]=yr
        if yr<=2021:
            eligible_song_ids.append(s['song_id'])

eligible_song_ids=sorted(set(eligible_song_ids))
print('eligible_library_song_ids_count', len(eligible_song_ids))
print('eligible_library_song_ids', eligible_song_ids)

# Gather owned and liked playlists and compute removals for eligible songs
owned_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    owned_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

liked_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    liked_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

playlist_title={}
for pl in owned_playlists+liked_playlists:
    playlist_title[pl['playlist_id']]=pl['title']

pairs=set() # (playlist_id, song_id)
for pl in owned_playlists+liked_playlists:
    present=set(pl.get('song_ids', []))
    for sid in present:
        if sid in eligible_song_ids:
            pairs.add((pl['playlist_id'], sid))

pairs=sorted(pairs)
print('total_playlist_song_pairs_to_remove', len(pairs))
print('playlist_song_pairs', pairs)

# Pretty map by playlist
from collections import defaultdict
by_playlist=defaultdict(list)
for pid,sid in pairs:
    by_playlist[pid].append(sid)
for pid in by_playlist:
    by_playlist[pid]=sorted(by_playlist[pid])
print('playlists_to_touch_count', len(by_playlist))
